description: A single patient found unresponsive in an office environment. No pulse, no breathing. Practice BLS protocol: CPR and AED application within the critical time window.

symptoms.what_happened: (Patient is unresponsive — coworker reports: He was at his desk, complained of chest tightness, then slumped over.)
symptoms.when_started: (Coworker: Maybe 3 minutes ago. I came back from the break room and found him like this.)

allergies.any_allergies: (Coworker: I think he mentioned a shellfish allergy once at lunch.)

medications.current_meds: (Coworker: He takes heart pills, I've seen him take them at lunch. Small white ones.)
medications.what_meds: (A pill organizer found in his desk drawer — labels: Aspirin 81mg, Lisinopril 10mg, Metformin 500mg.)

past_history.medical_conditions: (Coworker: He's diabetic, I know that. And he had a heart scare last year — was in hospital for a week.)

last_meal.when_ate: (Coworker: We had lunch together about an hour ago.)
last_meal.what_ate: (Coworker: He had pad thai from the canteen and iced tea.)

events.what_doing: (Coworker: He was working at his computer. Said he felt dizzy, then just... collapsed.)
events.witnesses: (Coworker: I was right here. Two other people in the office saw it too.)

opqrst.onset: (Coworker: He was sitting at his desk working. Said he felt dizzy and chest felt tight, then slumped forward.)
opqrst.quality: (Coworker: He grabbed his chest and said it felt like something was crushing him.)
opqrst.radiation: (Patient is unresponsive — could not describe radiation.)
opqrst.severity: (Coworker: He said 'really bad' before he lost consciousness.)
opqrst.time_course: (Coworker: It came on suddenly. No warning signs before today.)

examination_findings.head: ⚠ Face and lips cyanotic. Pupils bilaterally fixed and dilated at 6mm — consistent with cardiac arrest and hypoxia. No head trauma. GCS 3 (E1V1M1).
examination_findings.neck: No carotid pulse palpable. No JVD. Trachea midline. No neck trauma. Airway clear on chin-lift.
examination_findings.chest: ⚠ No spontaneous chest rise. No breath sounds bilaterally. No chest trauma. AED deployed — VF rhythm confirmed on monitor. CPR site identified: lower half of sternum. Begin 30:2 compression-to-ventilation cycle.
examination_findings.abdomen: Soft. No distension. No guarding. No visible trauma.
examination_findings.pelvis: No pelvic injury. No incontinence noted.
examination_findings.back: No visible back injuries. No trauma mechanism.
examination_findings.extremities: ⚠ Skin cool, cyanotic, mottled peripherally. No distal pulses. No deformity. Pill organiser found in drawer: Aspirin 81mg, Lisinopril 10mg, Metformin 500mg — note elevated BGL 180 mg/dL consistent with diabetes.
